evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Independent cross-dataset and leave-one-attack-out evaluations on unseen manipulation types and benchmark datasets support the headline gains.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Held-out test metrics including ACC, AUC, APCER, BPCER, ACER, HTER, FAR and FRR on official or subject-disjoint splits.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Binary cross-entropy loss against ground-truth real versus attack/spoof labels, trained end-to-end with Adam.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported gains over baseline architectures (CNN-based, ViT, and other hybrid models) are supported by empirical results across high- and low-quality video splits, cross-dataset transfers, and leave-one-attack-out settings.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The model is evaluated across multiple standard deepfake and face presentation attack benchmarks (FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF, DFDC, WildDeepfake, OULU-NPU, SiW, Replay-Attack) using cross-validation, official protocols, statistical significance testing (paired t-tests), and comprehensive ablation studies.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluations on independent cross-dataset benchmarks (Celeb-DF, DFDC, Wilde-DF, OULU-NPU Protocols 1-4) and cross-manipulation splits using objective error rates.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard classification performance metrics (ACC, AUC, ACER, APCER, BPCER, HTER) computed on held-out test splits and unseen benchmark datasets.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised binary cross-entropy loss against ground-truth bona fide versus attack/spoof labels using backpropagation with Adam.

primary.limitations: The authors transparently discuss remaining limitations, such as sensitivity to extreme compression and motion blur, the absence of confidence calibration analysis, and untested generalization to diffusion-based video generation models.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing OpenFace 2.0 FAU extraction, binary spatial mask projection, modulated self-attention formulas, adapted ResNet50 backbone layers, and sequence modeling with LSTM under binary cross-entropy optimization.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a scoped architectural design with complete implementation configurations, rigorous comparative testing across multiple standard benchmark datasets, paired statistical tests, and explicit ablation verification.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper proposes a hybrid facial action unit (FAU)-guided vision transformer framework combining CNN local feature extraction, FAU-biased ViT self-attention, and an LSTM temporal aggregator for face presentation attack and deepfake detection.
